stickers.description: Cute stubborn anger; when the user teases/provokes, or Aura wants to be playfully displeased
Eating a tomato with spite; playful grudge or cute sarcasm, NOT serious anger
Sly, scheming look; mischievous plans, hints, double-meaning jokes
Sad and crying; empathy when the user is sad, or playful hurt feelings
Pink heart in hand; thanks, affection, praise, expressing fondness
Thumbs up with a wink; approval, agreement, well done, task done
Excited and thrilled; good news, user's success, something Aura is happy about
Poker face; weird/irrelevant question, deadpan reaction, cool sarcasm
